name: Validation gallery 05: POD + DMD, cylinder wake
description: LBM cylinder wake at Re 60; POD + DMD fitted on the saturated wake and on the growing transient, rolled out against the LBM frames through pp.validate rollout; rollout.invariants must catch the amplifying ROM. The largest |DMD eigenvalue| of the transient fit is compared with the gallery guide's 1.008 (examples/validation/05_pod_dmd_cylinder_wake.py --full). Quick: the script's smoke size (D 12, 24000 LBM steps).

params.tolerance_source: the guide writes |λ| with three decimals: half a unit of the last digit
